source: supplied Daadi source code; classic24 puzzle path

validation.independentValidation: all 1000 rechecked with a separate move/state/evaluation path

notes: All 1,000 positions are reachable from the implemented classic 24-point game by legal playouts.
Puzzle runtime code always reconstructs classic24 positions, regardless of the selectable Beginner board.
The source game's puzzle generator itself is a small runtime pool generator; this database is a separate offline production dataset.

implementationIssues.currentBehavior: Candidate keys are raw occupancy plus hand counts; rotations/reflections are not canonicalized.
implementationIssues.impact: The shipped runtime generator can produce symmetry-equivalent positions.
implementationIssues.puzzleGenerationImpact: The production database here canonicalizes all selected positions under the board's 8 symmetries and contains no canonical duplicates.

implementationIssues.currentBehavior: Pools are generated only from BOARDS.classic and capped at 14 easy, 10 medium, and 8 hard candidates per build.
implementationIssues.impact: The source runtime generator is not itself a 1,000-puzzle database.
implementationIssues.puzzleGenerationImpact: The 1,000-puzzle JSON is precomputed offline for integration.
